title: Landforms with special significance

draft.title: Landforms with special significance
card: Some landforms hold special meaning for the Traditional Owners of the Country where they stand. Traditional Owners are the First Nations people with long-standing connection to that Country.
Uluru is a sacred place for the Anangu. It has Anangu names, stories and rules about how people should behave there.
Budj Bim is in Gunditjmara Country in Victoria. It holds ancient eel traps, built by the Gunditjmara using channels and ponds in the lava flow.
Such places have names, stories and meanings for their Traditional Owners. These meanings come from their long connection to the place, not only from how the landform looks.
draft.remember: Special places carry names, stories and meanings that belong to their Traditional Owners.

a.q: Which Country is Budj Bim part of?
opts: Gunditjmara Country
Anangu Country
Torres Strait Islander Country
Country shared by all Australians
a.why: Budj Bim is in Gunditjmara Country and holds ancient eel traps. Uluru is Anangu Country, so Anangu is the tempting wrong answer.
a.clue: The eel traps were built by the Traditional Owners there.

b.q: Why is Uluru significant to the Anangu?
opts: It is sacred, with Anangu stories, names and rules
It is the tallest mountain in Australia
It is where the Gunditjmara built eel traps
It was only valued after tourists began visiting
b.why: Uluru holds sacred meaning for the Anangu through their stories, names and rules. Its size or tourism does not explain this meaning.
b.clue: Think about meaning, not size or visitors.

b.best: It is sacred, with Anangu stories, names and rules

problems.detail: The right option is the only one that repeats 'Anangu' from the question stem, so a student could match words and pick it without knowing the idea. The clue then rules out the size and tourism options, leaving only the obviously wrong Gunditjmara option against it.

check.summary: The facts about Uluru and Budj Bim check out, and both questions have one clear right answer. One small flag: in question b, the right option echoes 'Anangu' from the stem and the clue rules out two distractors, so the question is easy to guess.

opts: Those parts carry meanings and rules from the Anangu
Those parts are special only for how the rock looks
